scope: Draft notices from pinned Bun build sources across platforms. This is not a complete native or transitive inventory. Platform-specific binary coverage, source/relink delivery, embedded models and legal approval remain UNVERIFIED. Rust crate notices include the pinned workspace lockfile inventory, potentially including test or unused dependencies; this is not proof of per-platform binary inclusion. The initial filename scan missed ten crate notices: eight now have exact-source-revision supplements, r-efi uses its packaged AUTHORS permission text, and selectors uses its original source notice plus the referenced canonical MPL text. Source availability and legal acceptance remain unverified.
